## Summary

[Partial] Locate fuse 11 to identify power supply for cruise lights and trace ground connections supplied by the cruise computer. [t1295]

[Partial] Inspect the 7-Pin trailer harness where two 4-pin connectors join to look for corrosion. [t1295]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Locate fuse 11 in the main fuse panel to identify power supply for cruise lights.
2. Trace ground connections supplied by the cruise computer that light up the dash LED.

_Procedure reported by [t1295]._

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] If the dashboard light is intermittent, suspect a fault in the cruise computer rather than just the switch. [t1295]
- Look for corrosion caused by salt and brine from rear wheels that may have broken off a pin inside the connector. [t1295]
